reviews.text: Worst booking site. I had an emergency and had to cancel my trip I requested a cancellation and it was immediately denied because the hotel declined it. I called the hotel and they confirmed they would refund it, I reached out to Agoda and they said they would “look into it” never did and when I called the next day it was denied even though the hotel said they would approve it.

Bank confirmed payment, Agoda claimed unpaid. I booked flights through Agoda and paid by QR code. My bank confirmed the payment was processed and deducted from my account, but Agoda claimed payment was not made.
I provided booking IDs, QR payment proof, bank debit screenshots, and support/chat records. I spent more than 5 hours trying to resolve this through Agoda’s automated systems, LINE support, website support, and email.
LINE support rejected the booking because it only supports hotels, not flights. Website support routed me through bots before I could submit documents. Agoda then said the case may take 3 5 working days to review.
Because Agoda failed to verify the bank-confirmed payment in time, I had to book replacement flights elsewhere.
Be very careful using QR payment for Agoda flight bookings. Save every screenshot and bank confirmation.

Edit: Agoda’s “developer response” is classic. They completely ignore what I wrote and replied with only the most generic text. This demonstrates exactly what is wrong with them. No attention to detail and absolutely the worst customer service. I’ll be booking directly with hotels from now on. All of these booking services are scams, but Agoda is truly the bottom of the barrel.

Я оформила бронирование через приложение Agoda, выбрав конкретный, рекомендованный друзьями отель на нужные мне даты. Через несколько дней я снова зашла в приложение, чтобы забронировать жилье в другом месте. И в этот момент система выдала мне баннер именно с тем отелем, который я уже забронировала, предлагая оформить бронь на те же самые даты. При этом моего ранее сделанного бронирования просто не было видно. Да, я признаю, что совершила ошибку и не проверила списание по банковской карте, доверившись интерфейсу, и оформила повторное бронирование.

И только когда вторая бронь была подтверждена, в системе вдруг отобразились сразу два активных заказа. Я незамедлительно связалась с поддержкой Agoda, чтобы отменить ошибочный дубликат.
Сначала мне ответили, что отправят запрос в отель, и предложили мне самой связаться с администрацией. Отель ответил мне очень оперативно: они объяснили, что технически не могут отменить это со своей стороны, и я должна сделать это через приложение или поддержку. В итоге служба поддержки Agoda тянула время несколько дней. А когда я уже приехала на место, мне заявили, что «партнеры отклонили бесплатную отмену». К сожалению, это ложь. Отель подтвердил, что не имел никаких возражений, и это решение принималось исключительно со стороны платформы Agoda.

Повторное бронирование произошло по вине технического сбоя приложения, которое настойчиво предлагало забронировать уже занятые мною даты и скрыло активный заказ. 

Мне очень жаль, что пришлось столкнуться с таким отношением. Раньше я пользовалась этим сервисом, и он казался мне вполне неплохим. Но после этой ситуации я удаляю приложение и больше никогда к нему не вернусь.

А для путешественников из России дополнительно отмечу: к нам полноценно вернулся Booking, так что больше нет никакого смысла искать ему замену и рисковать своими финансами.

reviews.text: SCAM - do not book trips through this app!. To make an extremely long horror story short, I thought I found a great deal for Atlantic City, NJ’s “Ocean Resort Casino.” I ignored my gut that this app looked fishy because I wanted to surprise my fiancé for his 50th birthday and it was short notice. When I called the hotel directly to confirm I was set, they saw the confirmation number. But NONE of my information matched me. I gave my name, last four of the card I used, mobile number, and none of that information matched. I contacted Agoda and they assured me that it takes up to 48 hours for everything to go over. I called back a week before the trip and they still confirmed no identifying information I gave matched the confirmation number I had. I had Ocean put a flag on the confirmation number and when I tried to contact Agoda to cancel, they claimed it was after hours and the “third party” THEY used to book would get back to me in 48 hours after I told them I needed an immediate resolution since the trip was so close. Everything is overseas. They lead you on to think you’re dealing with them but it’s really a “third party.” They claim they are not officiated through Expedia, but that’s what Ocean showed as the third party. Lies all around. I called my credit card company and they handled the charge for me, thank God. But stay FAR AWAY from this company because they claimed they would cancel for me and they still to this day never cancelled. I found out when I got to the hotel I had two confirmation numbers (I’m aware that makes no sense since Ocean claimed my name was not associated with that first confirmation number…but that’s a whole separate review about Ocean). STAY FAR AWAY FROM AGODA.

reviews.text:
Misleading Policies and Disappointing Stays Agoda Can’t Be Trusted. I’ve had an extremely frustrating experience with Agoda, and I feel compelled to warn others. Their policies come across as disingenuous at best what looks straightforward at booking often turns out to be anything but. Important terms are either buried in fine print or presented in a way that’s easy to misunderstand, especially around cancellations and refunds. When issues arise, it feels like the system is designed to protect the company rather than the customer.

Even more disappointing is the quality of many of the properties listed. The photos and descriptions frequently don’t match reality, and I’ve encountered accommodations that were far below acceptable standards. Cleanliness, maintenance, and overall condition have been consistently underwhelming, making it hard to trust the platform’s listings.

Customer support hasn’t been much help either. Responses are slow, generic, and often fail to resolve the issue. Instead of feeling supported, I was left feeling stuck with a bad booking and no meaningful recourse.

Overall, my experience with Agoda has been disappointing. Between misleading policies and questionable property quality, it’s a platform I no longer feel comfortable using.

reviews.text:
Miss Leading. I had a frustrating experience using Agoda. I searched for places that listed occupancy for up to 5 people. Based on that, I booked the property expecting everything to be covered.

However, when we arrived to check in, we were told that we had to pay extra fees for additional guests. This was very misleading, as the listing clearly indicated it could accommodate 5 people, yet did not make it clear that extra charges would apply per person.

The app itself is easy to use and does show competitive prices, but the lack of transparency around occupancy and pricing is a big issue. It creates confusion and unexpected costs at check-in, which can really impact your travel experience.

reviews.text: DISHONESTY!!. When searching hotels for a 5 night stay, Agoda's advertised prices were MUCH lower than all other sites. If I remember correctly, 25%-30% lower. Downloaded the app and booked the hotel. After 2 nights, I had a family emergency come up and had to checkout and return home. I checked out before noon after the 2nd night. I did not ask for, nor did I expect to be able to cancel for a refund of the 3rd night of booking. I did ask about nights 4 and 5. Per hotel policy, cancellation at least 24 hours before their advertised check in time of 4:00pm would allow for a full refund. The very friendly staff at the front desk informed me that I needed to request the cancellation and refund through Agoda as I had booked through them. After a couple hours of dealing with a bot in the app that continued to reply with non related information and refusing to provide a phone number, I asked the friendly hotel staff for something in writing stating they would agree to the refund as soon as they received the request from Agoda and was able to get a phone number via the transaction on my bank statement. The 1st hour of attempting to reach a human on the phone was similar to my attempts in the app. However, through my diligence I was on a call with an Agoda representative sometime between 4&5pm to request the cancellation and refund for the next 2 nights. After being told the same line over and over by the representative that there is no way to expect a refund and Agoda can't even request a refund from the hotel for nights I have already stayed, I think the representative finally understood I was only requesting a refund for 2 of the 3 nights I was canceling in advance. I only think this because the representative finally began putting me on hold for several minutes while she was "calling the hotel to request the refund". After more than 5 solid hours attempting to contact and finally contacting Agoda, the representative informed me that due to a communication barrier between her and the hotel, she would be requesting the refund via email and that I could expect to be contacted by Agoda with an update sometime over the next 3-5 days. After a week without being contacted by Agoda, I reached out to Agoda. After a few random disconnects, I was again speaking with an Agoda representative. After she placed me on hold and few times to allow her to research my case, she informed me that the hotel refused the refund. At ths time, I decided it would be best for me to end the call.

No human touch / we got scammed. The app itself works, but if you run into any issues with a vendor such as a hotel or vacation rental, expect to be ignored and stuck in an endless AI customer service loop.

When we arrived at our reservation in Saigon, the property was clearly unsanitary. There was old food waste in the trash bins, the bed had not been cleaned since the previous guest, and there was hair in the bathtub. It was obvious the room had not been properly cleaned.

We attempted to contact Agoda for assistance, but no one ever responded. Their website simply routed us through an infinite loop with an AI customer service “representative” that never actually helped.

In the end, we had to file a chargeback with our credit card provider just to get their attention. Now Agoda is claiming we are “past the cancellation period” and that they cannot assist. It is honestly unbelievable.

I would strongly recommend booking directly with the property or using a more established booking platform instead of Agoda. The service works fine until something goes wrong. When it does, they make the situation worse.
